sam_sales: Incoming security questionnaire from Prospect Orion (CAIQ). Link: https://files.redwood/prospect-orion/CAIQ.xlsx — need owner + ETA. POC kickoff targeted next Tue.
mia_security: dropping a note — I can take ownership of the CAIQ if we get the infra answers (BYOK/KMS, EU hosting) from eng.
eli_se: also FYI customer asked about pricing differences for Dedicated vs Hosted during POC. Can someone confirm quick ballpark?
jordan_eng: tagging to confirm BYOK: hosted doesn't support customer-managed HSM. Dedicated/VPC can with engineering effort and lead time. For the POC on hosted we should answer with our supported options and call out Dedicated as an alternative.
sam_sales: customer wants to try hosted first — will that be a showstopper if BYOK is a hard requirement?
jordan_eng: yes BYOK would require Dedicated. If they need keys in their control for compliance it blocks hosted. If they accept Redwood-managed keys we can proceed in eu-hosted.
mia_security: @jordan_eng can you provide a short snippet I can paste into CAIQ answers explaining BYOK status and timeline for Dedicated? I'll draft CAIQ answers once I have that.
sec_ops_bot: SOC2 report (redacted) available: https://vault/reports/SOC2-2025-redwood-redacted.pdf :thumbsup:
eli_se: pricing note (informal): Dedicated is capacity-commit pricing + setup; Hosted is usage-based. I'll attach formal numbers after scoping.
sam_sales: customer also asked about data residency (eu-west). Can we host the POC in eu? Any SLA caveats?
jordan_eng: eu-hosted is available for POC. If they require isolation or contractual guarantees we should move to Dedicated — that changes timeline and pricing.
eli_se: action items pinned: 1) mia_security to own CAIQ answers 2) jordan_eng to provide BYOK/KMS snippet + EU region notes 3) sam_sales to confirm POC scope & timeline with customer (hosted vs dedicated) 4) eli_se to prepare Dedicated pricing deck for scoping.
mia_security: ETA: will upload an initial CAIQ draft by EOD tomorrow, but BYOK phrasing depends on jordan's snippet. I'll mark any blockers that need Legal review.
sam_sales: customer expects a response by Fri COB — I'll mention the EOD draft and flag BYOK as a potential blocker.
eli_se: temporary pricing placeholder: `dedicated.monthly_commit = $XXk` (will refine). I'll follow up with a quote after we finalize scope.
mia_security: uploaded draft answers: https://drive/redwood/drafts/prospect-orion-caiq-draft.docx — please review and add comments @jordan_eng @eli_se
jordan_eng: looked through draft, added inline comments on KMS, network isolation, and EU region endpoints.
sam_sales: good — marking thread claimed. Will escalate if customer pushes BYOK requirement. :white_check_mark:
